intent.title: Collections with a typed schema and an editable grid
steps: Open the Data panel and make a collection.
Add, rename and retype fields; type values into the grid; filter, sort and limit it.
expected: Every value is stored in its field type’s canonical form; a value the type cannot hold is refused naming the row and the column.
Every list and item page showing the collection follows each change in the same undo step.

intent.title: Import CSV, TSV, JSON and XLSX as they are
steps: Import Carla’s cardapio.csv without reordering its columns.
Check the preview and each column’s type, then import it as a new collection or into one.
expected: The original file imports as it is; a file that cannot be read is refused naming the file and where.
An import is one undo step.

params.mode: updating the items by the first column

intent.title: Connect a card’s parts to fields and fill it from a collection
steps: Select a card; choose or drag the column each part shows.
Preview the first items, then Fill.
Edit an item and see every card follow.
expected: The list repeats the card for every item, images found by their file name.
A value no element can show is refused before any change, naming the row and the column.

intent.title: Many pages from one page
steps: Type the names of new pages, one per line, and make them from the open page.
Make a page per item of a collection.
expected: Each page is a copy named and filed as a duplicate is; the first opens.
An item’s page keeps its file when the item changes.

intent.title: A header, footer or menu shared by every page, edited once
steps: Select the header and share it with every page and the pages made later.
Edit its menu once on any page.
expected: Every page shows the edit at once, in one undo step.
A page made later receives it; a detached page keeps its own copy.
